Session tracker stores `response_id` from each completed Responses API request\n53\t  2. Session key is derived from SHA-256 hash of (model + first user message content)\n54\t  3. On subsequent requests with the same session key, only new messages are sent\n55\t  4. `previous_response_id` is injected into the Responses API request\n56\t  5. The provider maintains context across turns, enabling multi-million token sessions\n57\t- **Metrics**: Compaction hits/misses tracked in `/metrics` endpoint under `compaction` section\n58\t\n59\t#### Gap: Codex Workspace Integration\n60\t- **What**: Native Codex IDE/CLI integration features\n61\t- **Status**: ❌ Not available via API\n62\t- **Impact**: No access to Codex-specific agentic features\n63\t- **Note**: These features are GitHub Copilot specific\n64\t\n65\t### 2. {\n56\t\t\tresponsesReq.ToolChoice = transformToolChoiceToResponses(req.ToolChoice)\n57\t\t}\n58\t\n59\t\t// Transform thinking/reasoning parameters\n60\t\tapplyThinkingParametersToResponses(req, responsesReq, targetModel)\n61\t\n62\t\treturn responsesReq, nil\n63\t}\n64\t\n65\t// transformMessagesToInput converts Anthropic messages to Responses input format.\n66\tfunc transformMessagesToInput(req *models.AnthropicRequest) ([]models.ResponsesInput, error) {\n67\t\t// Pre-allocate with estimated capacity (at least one input per message, often more)\n68\t\tinputs := make([]models.ResponsesInput, 0, len(req.Messages)*2)\n69\t\n70\t\tfor _, msg := range req.Messages {\n71\t\t\tcontent, err := parseContent(msg.Content)\n72\t\t\tif err != nil {\n73\t\t\t\treturn nil, Completions uses \"call_xxx\" prefix, while Responses API requires \"fc_xxx\" prefix.\n165\tfunc translateToolCallID(id string) string {\n166\t\tif id == \"\" {\n167\t\t\treturn extractToolResultContent(block models.ContentBlock) string {\n221\t\tif block.Content == nil {\n222\t\t\treturn \"\"\n223\t\t}\n224\t\n225\t\t// Try as string first (most common case)\n226\t\tif str, json.Marshal(block.Content)\n248\t\tif err != nil {\n249\t\t\treturn \"\"\n250\t\t}\n251\t\treturn string(data)\n252\t}\n253\t\n254\t// transformAssistantMessageToInput converts an assistant message inputs\n298\t}\n299\t\n300\t// transformToolsToResponses converts Anthropic tools to Responses API format.\n301\t// The Responses API uses a flattened tool structure where name, description, and parameters\n302\t// are at the top level (not nested in a \"function\" object like Chat Completions API).\n303\t//\n304\t// IMPORTANT: We set Strict=false because Anthropic's tool schemas mark ALL parameters as\n305\t// required, but Claude Code only provides values for truly required parameters. With strict\n306\t// mode enabled, OpenAI rejects tool calls when optional parameters are missing.\n307\t//\n308\t// SPECIAL HANDLING: The \"WebSearch\" tool from Claude Code is intercepted and converted to\n309\t// OpenAI's native \"web_search_preview\" tool, which provides better search results and\n310\t// automatic citations.\n311\tfunc transformToolsToResponses(tools []models.AnthropicTool) []models.ResponsesTool {\n312\t\tresult := make([]models.ResponsesTool, 0, len(tools))\n313\t\tstrictFalse := false // Pointer to false for explicit strict:false\n314\t\thasWebSearch := false\n315\t\n316\t\tfor _, tool := range tools {\n317\t\t\t// Intercept WebSearch tool and convert to web_search_preview\n318\t\t\tif tool.Name == \"WebSearch\" {\n319\t\t\t\thasWebSearch = true\n320\t\t\t\tcontinue // Skip adding as function, will add web_search_preview instead\n321\t\t\t}\n322\t\n323\t\t\t// Get tool definition - use Claude Code tool definitions if applicable\n324\t\t\ttoolName := tool.Name\n325\t\t\ttoolDescription := tool.Description\n326\t\t\ttoolParams := tool.InputSchema\n327\t\n328\t\t\tif IsClaudeCodeTool(tool.Name) {\n329\t\t\t\ttoolName, toolDescription, toolParams = GetClaudeCodeToolDefinition(tool)\n330\t\t\t}\n331\t\n332\t\t\t// Clean up input schema and fix required array\n333\t\t\tparams := cleanupSchemaForResponses(toolParams)\n334\t\n335\t\t\t// Responses API uses a flattened structure with name at top level\n336\t\t\tresult = append(result, models.ResponsesTool{\n337\t\t\t\tType:        \"function\",\n338\t\t\t\tName:        toolName,\n339\t\t\t\tDescription: toolDescription,\n340\t\t\t\tParameters:  params,\n341\t\t\t\tStrict:      &strictFalse, // CRITICAL: Must set strict:false at top level for Responses API\n342\t\t\t\t// Also set Function for backwards compatibility, but Responses API\n343\t\t\t\t// primarily uses the top-level fields\n344\t\t\t\tFunction: &models.ResponsesFunction{\n345\t\t\t\t\tName:        toolName,\n346\t\t\t\t\tDescription: toolDescription,\n347\t\t\t\t\tParameters:  params,\n348\t\t\t\t\tStrict:      false, // CRITICAL: Don't use strict mode - Anthropic marks all params as required\n349\t\t\t\t},\n350\t\t\t})\n351\t\t}\n352\t\n353\t\t// Add web_search_preview tool if WebSearch was requested\n354\t\tif hasWebSearch {\n355\t\t\tresult = append(result, models.ResponsesTool{\n356\t\t\t\tType: \"web_search_preview\",\n357\t\t\t\t// Use medium search context for balanced speed/quality\n358\t\t\t\t// This field is at the tool level for web_search_preview\n359\t\t\t})\n360\t\t}\n361\t\n362\t\treturn result\n363\t}\n364\t\n365\t// cleanupSchemaForResponses prepares an Anthropic tool schema for the Responses API.\n366\t// This includes removing unsupported format types and fixing the required array\n367\t// to only include truly required parameters.\n368\tfunc cleanupSchemaForResponses(schema interface{}) interface{} {\n369\t\tif schema == nil {\n370\t\t\treturn nil\n371\t\t}\n372\t\n373\t\tdata, err := json.Marshal(schema)\n374\t\tif err != nil {\n375\t\t\treturn schema\n376\t\t}\n377\t\n378\t\tvar schemaMap map[string]interface{}\n379\t\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &schemaMap); err != nil {\n380\t\t\treturn schema\n381\t\t}\n382\t\n383\t\t// Clean up the schema\n384\t\tcleanupSchemaMapForResponses(schemaMap)\n385\t\treturn schemaMap\n386\t}\n387\t\n388\t// cleanupSchemaMapForResponses recursively cleans up schema properties for Responses API.\n389\t// Key fix: Only include truly required parameters (those without defaults and not nullable).\n390\t// Also adds \"additionalProperties\": false which is REQUIRED by OpenAI Responses API.\n391\tfunc cleanupSchemaMapForResponses(schema map[string]interface{}) {\n392\t\t// Remove unsupported format types\n393\t\tif format, ok := schema[\"format\"].(string); ok {\n394\t\t\tif format == \"uri\" {\n395\t\t\t\tdelete(schema, \"format\")\n396\t\t\t}\n397\t\t}\n398\t\n399\t\t// CRITICAL: Remove any \"strict\" field from the schema itself\n400\t\t// Claude Code may include \"strict\": true in tool definitions, which causes\n401\t\t// validation failures when optional parameters are missing.\n402\t\tdelete(schema, \"strict\")\n403\t\n404\t\t// CRITICAL: Add additionalProperties: false at top level of object schemas\n405\t\t// OpenAI Responses API REQUIRES this even when strict: false is set.\n406\t\t// Without this, you get: \"Invalid schema for function '...': 'additionalProperties'\n407\t\t// is required to be supplied and to be false\"\n408\t\tif schemaType, ok := schema[\"type\"].(string); ok && schemaType == \"object\" {\n409\t\t\tschema[\"additionalProperties\"] = false\n410\t\t}\n411\t\n412\t\t// Process properties and fix required array\n413\t\tif props, ok := schema[\"properties\"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {\n414\t\t\t// Identify truly required parameters\n415\t\t\ttrulyRequired := identifyTrulyRequired(props, schema)\n416\t\t\tif len(trulyRequired) > 0 {\n417\t\t\t\tschema[\"required\"] = trulyRequired\n418\t\t\t} else {\n419\t\t\t\t// If no truly required params, remove required array entirely\n420\t\t\t\tdelete(schema, \"required\")\n421\t\t\t}\n422\t\n423\t\t\t// Recurse into properties\n424\t\t\tfor _, v := range props {\n425\t\t\t\tif propMap, ok := v.(map[string]interface{}); ok {\n426\t\t\t\t\tcleanupSchemaMapForResponses(propMap)\n427\t\t\t\t}\n428\t\t\t}\n429\t\t}\n430\t\n431\t\t// Recurse into items (for arrays)\n432\t\tif items, ok := schema[\"items\"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {\n433\t\t\tcleanupSchemaMapForResponses(items)\n434\t\t}\n435\t}\n436\t\n437\t// identifyTrulyRequired determines which parameters are truly required.\n438\t// A parameter is truly required if:\n439\t// 1. It appears in the original required array\n440\t// 2. It doesn't have a default value\n441\t// 3. It's not nullable\n442\t// 4. It doesn't have a description containing optional-indicating phrases\n443\t// 5. It's not a boolean type (booleans are almost always optional flags)\n444\tfunc identifyTrulyRequired(props, schema map[string]interface{}) []string {\n445\t\t// Pre-allocate with estimated capacity\n446\t\ttrulyRequired := make([]string, 0, len(props)/2)\n447\t\n448\t\t// Get original required array\n449\t\toriginalRequired := make(map[string]bool)\n450\t\tif req, ok := schema[\"required\"].([]interface{}); ok {\n451\t\t\tfor _, r := range req {\n452\t\t\t\tif s, ok := r.(string); ok {\n453\t\t\t\t\toriginalRequired[s] = true\n454\t\t\t\t}\n455\t\t\t}\n456\t\t}\n457\t\n458\t\tfor propName, propVal := range props {\n459\t\t\tpropMap, ok := propVal.(map[string]interface{})\n460\t\t\tif !ok {\n461\t\t\t\tcontinue\n462\t\t\t}\n463\t\n464\t\t\t// Skip if not in original required array\n465\t\t\tif !originalRequired[propName] {\n466\t\t\t\tcontinue\n467\t\t\t}\n468\t\n469\t\t\t// Skip if it has a default value\n470\t\t\tif _, hasDefault := propMap[\"default\"]; hasDefault {\n471\t\t\t\tcontinue\n472\t\t\t}\n473\t\n474\t\t\t// Skip if nullable\n475\t\t\tif nullable, ok := propMap[\"nullable\"].(bool); ok && nullable {\n476\t\t\t\tcontinue\n477\t\t\t}\n478\t\n479\t\t\t// Skip boolean types - they're almost always optional flags\n480\t\t\tif propType, ok := propMap[\"type\"].(string); ok && propType == \"boolean\" {\n481\t\t\t\tcontinue\n482\t\t\t}\n483\t\n484\t\t\t// Skip if description indicates it's optional\n485\t\t\tif desc, ok := propMap[\"description\"].(string); ok {\n486\t\t\t\tdescLower := strings.ToLower(desc)\n487\t\t\t\tif strings.Contains(descLower, \"optional\") ||\n488\t\t\t\t\tstrings.Contains(descLower, \"(optional)\") ||\n489\t\t\t\t\tstrings.Contains(descLower, \"if not specified\") ||\n490\t\t\t\t\tstrings.Contains(descLower, \"defaults to\") ||\n491\t\t\t\t\tstrings.Contains(descLower, \"set to true to\") ||\n492\t\t\t\t\tstrings.Contains(descLower, \"set to false to\") ||\n493\t\t\t\t\tstrings.Contains(descLower, \"if provided\") ||\n494\t\t\t\t\tstrings.Contains(descLower, \"when provided\") ||\n495\t\t\t\t\tstrings.Contains(descLower, \"can be omitted\") ||\n496\t\t\t\t\tstrings.Contains(descLower, \"not required\") {\n497\t\t\t\t\tcontinue\n498\t\t\t\t}\n499\t\t\t}\n500\t\n501\t\t\ttrulyRequired = append(trulyRequired, propName)\n502\t\t}\n503\t\n504\t\treturn trulyRequired\n505\t}\n506\t\n507\t// transformToolChoiceToResponses converts Anthropic tool_choice to Responses API format.\n508\tfunc transformToolChoiceToResponses(choice interface{}) interface{} {\n509\t\tif choice == nil {\n510\t\t\treturn nil\n511\t\t}\n512\t\n513\t\t// Handle map format\n514\t\tif choiceMap, ok := choice.(map[string]interface{}); ok {\n515\t\t\tif typeVal, ok := choiceMap[\"type\"].(string); ok {\n516\t\t\t\tswitch typeVal {\n517\t\t\t\tcase \"none\":\n518\t\t\t\t\treturn \"none\"\n519\t\t\t\tcase \"any\":\n520\t\t\t\t\treturn \"required\"\n521\t\t\t\tcase \"auto\":\n522\t\t\t\t\treturn \"auto\"\n523\t\t\t\tcase \"tool\":\n524\t\t\t\t\tif name, ok := choiceMap[\"name\"].(string); ok {\n525\t\t\t\t\t\treturn map[string]interface{}{\n526\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"type\": \"function\",\n527\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"function\": map[string]interface{}{\n528\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"name\": name,\n529\t\t\t\t\t\t\t},\n530\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n531\t\t\t\t\t}\n532\t\t\t\t}\n533\t\t\t}\n534\t\t}\n535\t\n536\t\treturn choice\n537\t}\n538\t\n539\t// applyThinkingParametersToResponses maps thinking parameters for Responses API.\n540\t// The Responses API requires reasoning parameters under the nested \"reasoning\" object.\n541\tfunc applyThinkingParametersToResponses(req *models.AnthropicRequest, responsesReq *models.ResponsesRequest, targetModel string) {\n542\t\tif req.Thinking == nil || req.Thinking.BudgetTokens <= 0 {\n543\t\t\treturn\n544\t\t}\n545\t\n546\t\tbudgetTokens := req.Thinking.BudgetTokens\n547\t\n548\t\t// For GPT-5+ models via Responses API, use nested reasoning.effort\n549\t\t// The Responses API {\n82\t\tsp.mu.Lock()\n83\t\tdefer sp.mu.Unlock()\n84\t\treturn sp.responseID\n85\t}\n86\t\n87\t// SetUsageCallback sets the callback function for usage reporting.\n88\tfunc (sp usage statistics from the stream.\n95\tfunc (sp *ResponsesStreamProcessor) GetUsage() (inputTokens, outputTokens int) {\n96\t\tsp.mu.Lock()\n97\t\tdefer sp.mu.Unlock()\n98\t\tif sp.usage != nil {\n99\t\t\treturn sp.usage.InputTokens, sp.usage.OutputTokens\n100\t\t}\n101\t\treturn 0, 0\n102\t}\n103\t\n104\t// ProcessStream reads an OpenAI Responses API SSE stream and writes Anthropic SSE events.\n105\tfunc (sp *ResponsesStreamProcessor) ProcessStream(reader io.Reader) error {\n106\t\tscanner := bufio.NewScanner(reader)\n107\t\tbuf := make([]byte, 0, 64*1024)\n108\t\tscanner.Buffer(buf, 1024*1024)\n109\t\n110\t\tlogging.LogDebugMessage(\"[STREAM] Starting Responses API SSE stream processing for model: %s\", sp.targetModel)\n111\t\n112\t\tfor scanner.Scan() {\n113\t\t\tline := scanner.Text()\n114\t\n115\t\t\tif line == \"\" {\n116\t\t\t\tcontinue\n117\t\t\t}\n118\t\n119\t\t\tif strings.HasPrefix(line, \"data: \") {\n120\t\t\t\tdata := sp.finalize()\n125\t\t\t\t}\n126\t\n127\t\t\t\t// Debug log incoming Responses API SSE event\n128\t\t\t\tlogging.LogDebugSSE(\"INCOMING Responses API\", \"event\", data)\n129\t\n130\t\t\t\tvar event models.ResponsesStreamEvent\n131\t\t\t\tif err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(data), &event); err != nil {\n132\t\t\t\t\tlogging.LogDebugMessage(\"[STREAM] Error parsing Responses API event: %v\", err)\n133\t\t\t\t\tcontinue\n134\t\t\t\t}\n135\t\n136\t\t\t\tif err := sp.processEvent(&event); err != nil {\n137\t\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"processing event: %w\", err)\n138\t\t\t\t}\n139\t\t\t}\n140\t\t}\n141\t\n142\t\tif err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {\n143\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"scanning stream: %w\", err)\n144\t\t}\n145\t\n146\t\treturn sp.finalize()\n147\t}\n148\t\n149\t// processEvent handles a single Responses API stream event.\n150\tfunc (sp *ResponsesStreamProcessor) processEvent(event *models.ResponsesStreamEvent) error {\n151\t\tsp.mu.Lock()\n152\t\tdefer sp.mu.Unlock()\n153\t\n154\t\t// Deduplicate events using sequence number\n155\t\t// The Responses API may send the same content through multiple event types\n156\t\t// (e.g., content_part.delta and output_text.delta) with the same sequence number\n157\t\tif event.SequenceNumber > 0 {\n158\t\t\tif sp.seenSequenceNumbers[event.SequenceNumber] sp.handleResponseCompleted(event)\n174\t\tcase models.EventResponseFailed:\n175\t\t\treturn sp.handleResponseFailed(event)\n176\t\tcase models.EventResponseIncomplete:\n177\t\t\treturn sp.handleResponseIncomplete(event)\n178\t\n179\t\t// Output item events\n180\t\tcase models.EventOutputItemAdded:\n181\t\t\treturn sp.handleOutputItemAdded(event)\n182\t\tcase models.EventOutputItemDone:\n183\t\t\treturn sp.handleOutputItemDone(event)\n184\t\n185\t\t// Content part events (legacy format)\n186\t\tcase models.EventContentPartDelta:\n187\t\t\treturn sp.handleContentPartDelta(event)\n188\t\tcase models.EventContentPartDone:\n189\t\t\treturn sp.handleContentPartDone(event)\n190\t\tcase models.EventContentPartAdded:\n191\t\t\t// Content part initialization, handled by output_item.added\n192\t\t\treturn nil\n193\t\n194\t\t// Primary text streaming events (newer format)\n195\t\tcase models.EventOutputTextDelta:\n196\t\t\treturn sp.handleOutputTextDelta(event)\n197\t\tcase models.EventOutputTextDone:\n198\t\t\t// Final text, but we've already streamed the deltas\n199\t\t\treturn nil\n200\t\tcase models.EventOutputTextAnnotationAdd:\n201\t\t\treturn sp.handleAnnotationAdded(event)\n202\t\n203\t\t// Refusal events\n204\t\tcase models.EventRefusalDelta:\n205\t\t\treturn sp.handleRefusalDelta(event)\n206\t\tcase models.EventRefusalDone:\n207\t\t\treturn nil\n208\t\n209\t\t// Reasoning events\n210\t\tcase models.EventReasoningTextDelta, models.EventReasoningSummaryTextDelta:\n211\t\t\treturn sp.handleReasoningDelta(event)\n212\t\tcase models.EventReasoningTextDone, models.EventReasoningSummaryTextDone:\n213\t\t\treturn nil\n214\t\tcase models.EventReasoningSummaryPartAdded, models.EventReasoningSummaryPartDone:\n215\t\t\treturn nil\n216\t\n217\t\t// Function call events\n218\t\tcase models.EventFunctionCallArgs:\n219\t\t\treturn sp.handleFunctionCallDelta(event)\n220\t\tcase models.EventFunctionCallDone:\n221\t\t\t// Function call complete, handled by output_item.done\n222\t\t\treturn nil\n223\t\n224\t\t// Rate limit event\n225\t\tcase models.EventRateLimitsUpdated:\n226\t\t\t// Informational, no action needed\n227\t\t\treturn nil\n228\t\t}\n229\t\n230\t\treturn nil\n231\t}\n232\t\n233\t// handleResponseCreated handles the response.created event.\n234\tfunc (sp *ResponsesStreamProcessor) handleResponseCreated(event *models.ResponsesStreamEvent) error {\n235\t\tif event.Response != nil {\n236\t\t\tsp.responseID = event.Response.ID\n237\t\t}\n238\t\n239\t\t// Emit message_start\n240\t\tif sp.state == StateIdle TranslateResponsesIDToAnthropic converts Responses API function call IDs back to Anthropic format.\n340\t// Responses API uses \"fc_xxx\" prefix, Anthropic/Chat Completions uses \"call_xxx\".\n341\t// This function is exported for use by the proxy handler.\n342\tfunc TranslateResponsesIDToAnthropic(id string) string {\n343\t\tif id == \"\" {\n344\t\t\treturn id\n345\t\t}\n346\t\n347\t\t// Convert format\n358\t\treturn \"call_\" + id\n359\t}\n360\t\n361\t// handleContentPartDelta handles the response.content_part.delta event.\n362\t// NOTE: This may be sent alongside output_text.delta with the text content from the stream.\n381\tfunc (sp *ResponsesStreamProcessor) handleTextDelta(text string) error {\n382\t\tif text == \"\" {\n383\t\t\treturn nil\n384\t\t}\n385\t\n386\t\t// Emit sp.emitContentBlockDelta(sp.textBlockIndex, \"text_delta\", text, \"\")\n414\t}\n415\t\n416\t// handleFunctionCallDelta handles function call argument deltas.\n417\t// Note: For The custom unmarshaller stores this in DeltaText.\n419\tfunc (sp *ResponsesStreamProcessor) handleFunctionCallDelta(event *models.ResponsesStreamEvent) error {\n420\t\t// For function call arguments, delta is a string stored in DeltaText\n421\t\tdeltaStr := event.DeltaText\n422\t\tif deltaStr == \"\" && event.Delta != nil {\n423\t\t\t// Fallback to nested Delta.Delta for other formats\n424\t\t\tdeltaStr = event.Delta.Delta\n425\t\t}\n426\t\n427\t\tif deltaStr == \"\" {\n428\t\t\treturn nil\n429\t\t}\n430\t\n431\t\t// Find the matching function call state\n432\t\tfor _, fcState := range sp.activeFuncCalls {\n433\t\t\tif !fcState.started || fcState.closed {\n434\t\t\t\tcontinue\n435\t\t\t}\n436\t\t\tfcState.arguments += deltaStr\n437\t\t\tif err := sp.emitContentBlockDelta(fcState.blockIndex, \"input_json_delta\", \"\", deltaStr); err != nil {\n438\t\t\t\treturn err\n439\t\t\t}\n440\t\t\tbreak\n441\t\t}\n442\t\n443\t\treturn nil\n444\t}\n445\t\n446\t// handleContentPartDone handles completion of a content part.\n447\tfunc (sp *ResponsesStreamProcessor) handleContentPartDone(event *models.ResponsesStreamEvent) error {\n448\t\t// Content part completion is handled by output_item.done\n449\t\treturn nil\n450\t}\n451\t\n452\t// handleOutputItemDone handles completion of an output item.\n453\tfunc (sp *ResponsesStreamProcessor) handleOutputItemDone(event *models.ResponsesStreamEvent) error {\n454\t\tif event.Item == nil {\n455\t\t\treturn nil\n456\t\t}\n457\t\n458\t\tswitch event.Item.Type {\n459\t\tcase \"message\":\n460\t\t\t// Close text block if open\n461\t\t\tif sp.textStarted {\n462\t\t\t\tif err := sp.emitContentBlockStop(sp.textBlockIndex); err != nil {\n463\t\t\t\t\treturn err\n464\t\t\t\t}\n465\t\t\t}\n466\t\tcase \"function_call\":\n467\t\t\t// Close function call block\n468\t\t\t// Note: fcState.id is in Anthropic format (call_xxx), but event.Item.CallID is\n469\t\t\t// in Responses API format (fc_xxx). served from cache.\nfunc (h *Handler) checkCache(w http.ResponseWriter, req *models.AnthropicRequest) (string, bool) {\n\tif h.cache == nil || req.Stream {\n\t\treturn \"\", false\n\t}\n\n\tcacheKey, cacheable := GenerateCacheKey(req)\n\tif !cacheable {\n\t\treturn \"\", false\n\t}\n\n\tif cachedResp, found := h.cache.Get(cacheKey); found {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Cache HIT for request\")\n\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.SuccessRequests, 1)\n\t\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n\t\tw.Header().Set(\"X-CLASP-Cache\", \"HIT\")\n\t\t_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(cachedResp)\n\t\treturn \"HIT\", true\n\t}\n\n\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Cache MISS for request\")\n\treturn cacheKey, cacheable\n}\n\n// promptCacheCtx holds prompt cache key and token estimate for a request.\ntype promptCacheCtx struct {\n\tkey    string\n\ttokens int\n}\n\n// tryStorePromptCache stores a response in the prompt cache if a pending context exists.\n// The cacheKey parameter is the regular cache key used to look up the prompt cache context.\nfunc (h *Handler) tryStorePromptCache(cacheKey string, resp *models.AnthropicResponse) {\n\tif h.promptCache == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif val, ok := h.promptCachePending.LoadAndDelete(cacheKey); ok {\n\t\tctx := val.(promptCacheCtx)\n\t\th.promptCache.Set(ctx.key, resp, ctx.tokens)\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Response stored in prompt cache (prefix ~%d tokens)\", ctx.tokens)\n\t}\n}\n\n// selectProviderAndModel selects the appropriate provider and target model.\nfunc (h *Handler) selectProviderAndModel(req *models.AnthropicRequest) (provider.Provider, string) {\n\tselectedProvider := h.provider\n\ttierCfg := h.cfg.GetTierConfig(req.Model)\n\tvar targetModel string\n\n\tif tierCfg != nil {\n\t\ttier := config.GetModelTier(req.Model)\n\t\tif tierProvider, ok := h.tierProviders[tier]; ok {\n\t\t\tselectedProvider = tierProvider\n\t\t\ttargetModel = tierCfg.Model\n\t\t\tif targetModel == \"\" {\n\t\t\t\ttargetModel = h.cfg.MapModel(req.Model)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Multi-provider routing: %s -> %s via %s\", req.Model, targetModel, tierCfg.Provider)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\ttargetModel = h.cfg.MapModel(req.Model)\n\t\t\ttargetModel = selectedProvider.TransformModelID(targetModel)\n\t\t}\n\t} else {\n\t\ttargetModel = h.cfg.MapModel(req.Model)\n\t\ttargetModel = selectedProvider.TransformModelID(targetModel)\n\t}\n\n\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Request: %s -> %s (streaming: %v, provider: %s, passthrough: %v)\",\n\t\treq.Model, targetModel, req.Stream, selectedProvider.Name(), !selectedProvider.RequiresTransformation())\n\n\treturn selectedProvider, targetModel\n}\n\n// transformAndExecute transforms the request and executes it against the provider.\nfunc (h *Handler) transformAndExecute(ctx interface{ Done() <-chan struct{} }, req *models.AnthropicRequest, selectedProvider provider.Provider, targetModel, previousResponseID string, newMessagesOffset int) (*http.Response, string, bool, bool, error) {\n\tendpointType := translator.GetEndpointType(targetModel)\n\tuseResponsesAPI := endpointType == translator.EndpointResponses\n\n\t// Set target model on provider for endpoint URL selection\n\tif openaiProvider, ok := selectedProvider.(*provider.OpenAIProvider); ok {\n\t\topenaiProvider.SetTargetModel(targetModel)\n\t}\n\n\t// Transform request\n\treqBody, err := h.transformRequest(req, targetModel, useResponsesAPI, previousResponseID, newMessagesOffset)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, targetModel, useResponsesAPI, false, err\n\t}\n\n\t// Execute request\n\tresp, err := h.doRequestWithRetry(ctx, reqBody, selectedProvider)\n\tusedFallback := false\n\n\t// Check if we should try fallback\n\tif err != nil || (resp != nil && resp.StatusCode >= 500) {\n\t\tresp, targetModel, useResponsesAPI, usedFallback, err = h.tryFallback(ctx, req, resp, targetModel, err)\n\t}\n\n\treturn resp, targetModel, useResponsesAPI, usedFallback, err\n}\n\n// transformRequest transforms an Anthropic request to the appropriate format.\n// previousResponseID and newMessagesOffset are used for Responses API compaction:\n// when set, only the messages after newMessagesOffset are sent (the rest are\n// captured by the previous_response_id chain).\nfunc (h *Handler) transformRequest(req *models.AnthropicRequest, targetModel string, useResponsesAPI bool, previousResponseID string, newMessagesOffset int) ([]byte, error) {\n\tif useResponsesAPI {\n\t\t// Apply compaction: trim messages to only the new ones when continuing a session.\n\t\treqToTransform := req\n\t\tif previousResponseID != \"\" {\n\t\t\tif newMessages := translator.TrimMessagesForCompaction(req.Messages, newMessagesOffset); newMessages != nil {\n\t\t\t\ttrimmed := *req\n\t\t\t\ttrimmed.Messages = newMessages\n\t\t\t\treqToTransform = &trimmed\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tresponsesReq, err := translator.TransformRequestToResponses(reqToTransform, targetModel, previousResponseID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error transforming request to Responses API: %v\", err)\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treqBody, err := json.Marshal(responsesReq)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error marshaling Responses request: %v\", err)\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif h.cfg.DebugRequests {\n\t\t\tdebugJSON, _ := json.MarshalIndent(responsesReq, \"\", \"  \")\n\t\t\tmaskedJSON := secrets.MaskJSONSecrets(debugJSON)\n\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP DEBUG] Outgoing OpenAI Responses API request:\\n%s\", string(maskedJSON))\n\t\t\tlogging.LogDebugRequestRaw(\"OUTGOING\", \"/v1/responses\", maskedJSON)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Using Responses API for model: %s\", targetModel)\n\t\treturn reqBody, nil\n\t}\n\n\topenAIReq, err := translator.TransformRequest(req, targetModel)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error transforming request: %v\", err)\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\treqBody, err := json.Marshal(openAIReq)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error marshaling request: %v\", err)\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tif h.cfg.DebugRequests {\n\t\tdebugJSON, _ := json.MarshalIndent(openAIReq, \"\", \"  \")\n\t\tmaskedJSON := secrets.MaskJSONSecrets(debugJSON)\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP DEBUG] Outgoing OpenAI Chat Completions request:\\n%s\", string(maskedJSON))\n\t\tlogging.LogDebugRequestRaw(\"OUTGOING\", \"/v1/chat/completions\", maskedJSON)\n\t}\n\n\treturn reqBody, nil\n}\n\n// tryFallback attempts to use a fallback provider if the primary fails.\nfunc (h *Handler) tryFallback(ctx interface{ Done() <-chan struct{} }, req *models.AnthropicRequest, resp *http.Response, targetModel string, originalErr error) (*http.Response, string, bool, bool, error) {\n\tfallbackProvider, fallbackModel := h.getFallbackProvider(req.Model)\n\tif fallbackProvider == nil {\n\t\treturn resp, targetModel, false, false, originalErr\n\t}\n\n\t// Close original response if it exists\n\tif resp != nil {\n\t\tresp.Body.Close()\n\t}\n\n\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.FallbackAttempts, 1)\n\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Primary provider failed, attempting fallback to %s\", fallbackProvider.Name())\n\n\t// Re-transform request with fallback model if specified\n\tuseResponsesAPI := false\n\tvar reqBody []byte\n\tif fallbackModel != \"\" {\n\t\ttargetModel = fallbackModel\n\t\tfallbackEndpointType := translator.GetEndpointType(fallbackModel)\n\t\tuseResponsesAPI = fallbackEndpointType == translator.EndpointResponses\n\n\t\tif openaiProvider, ok := fallbackProvider.(*provider.OpenAIProvider); ok {\n\t\t\topenaiProvider.SetTargetModel(targetModel)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tvar err error\n\t// Fallback always uses full context (no compaction) for safety.\n\treqBody, err = h.transformRequest(req, targetModel, useResponsesAPI, \"\", 0)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, targetModel, useResponsesAPI, false, err\n\t}\n\n\t// Try fallback provider\n\tresp, err = h.doRequestWithRetry(ctx, reqBody, fallbackProvider)\n\tif err == nil && resp.StatusCode < 500 {\n\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.FallbackSuccesses, 1)\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Fallback to %s succeeded\", fallbackProvider.Name())\n\t\treturn resp, targetModel, useResponsesAPI, true, nil\n\t}\n\n\treturn resp, targetModel, useResponsesAPI, false, err\n}\n\n// handleUpstreamError handles error responses from the upstream provider.\nfunc (h *Handler) handleUpstreamError(w http.ResponseWriter, resp *http.Response) {\n\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.ErrorRequests, 1)\n\tif h.circuitBreaker != nil && resp.StatusCode >= 500 {\n\t\th.circuitBreaker.RecordFailure()\n\t}\n\tbody, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)\n\tmaskedBody := secrets.MaskAllSecrets(string(body))\n\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Upstream error (%d): %s\", resp.StatusCode, maskedBody)\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n\tw.WriteHeader(resp.StatusCode)\n\t_, _ = w.Write(body)\n}\n\n// handleResponse routes the response to the appropriate handler.\n// sessionKey and messageCount are used for compaction session tracking on Responses API paths.\nfunc (h *Handler) handleResponse(w http.ResponseWriter, resp *http.Response, isStreaming, useResponsesAPI bool, targetModel, cacheKey string, cacheable bool, sessionKey string, messageCount int) {\n\tif isStreaming {\n\t\tif useResponsesAPI {\n\t\t\th.handleResponsesStreamingResponse(w, resp, targetModel, sessionKey, messageCount)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.handleStreamingResponse(w, resp, targetModel)\n\t\t}\n\t} else {\n\t\tif useResponsesAPI {\n\t\t\th.handleResponsesNonStreamingResponse(w, resp, targetModel, cacheKey, cacheable, sessionKey, messageCount)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.handleNonStreamingResponse(w, resp, targetModel, cacheKey, cacheable)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// checkPromptCache checks if the request can be served from the prompt cache.\n// Returns (\"HIT\", false, 0) if the response was served from cache, otherwise (\"\", cacheable, tokenEstimate).\n// The prompt cache implements prefix-based LRU caching that simulates Anthropic's\n// cache_control behavior for non-Anthropic backends.\nfunc (h *Handler) checkPromptCache(w http.ResponseWriter, req *models.AnthropicRequest) (string, bool, int) {\n\tif h.promptCache == nil || req.Stream {\n\t\treturn \"\", false, 0\n\t}\n\n\t// Check if request has cache_control markers and generate cache key\n\tcacheKey, tokenEstimate, cacheable := cache.GeneratePromptCacheKey(req)\n\tif !cacheable {\n\t\treturn \"\", false, 0\n\t}\n\n\t// Look up in cache\n\tcachedResp, _, found := h.promptCache.Get(cacheKey)\n\tif !found {\n\t\t// Cache miss - return key and token estimate for later storage\n\t\treturn \"\", true, tokenEstimate\n\t}\n\n\t// Cache hit - write response\n\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Prompt cache HIT (prefix match, ~%d tokens saved)\", tokenEstimate)\n\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.SuccessRequests, 1)\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n\tw.Header().Set(\"X-CLASP-Cache\", \"HIT\")\n\tw.Header().Set(\"X-CLASP-Prompt-Cache\", \"HIT\")\n\t_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(cachedResp)\n\treturn \"HIT\", false, 0\n}\n\n// handlePassthroughRequest handles requests that don't require transformation.\n// This is used for direct Anthropic API passthrough where the request is already\n// in the correct format. The _ string and _ int params are reserved for\n// future prompt-cache integration (promptCacheKey, promptCacheTokens).\nfunc (h *Handler) handlePassthroughRequest(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, anthropicReq *models.AnthropicRequest, p provider.Provider, start time.Time, cacheKey string, cacheable bool) {\n\t// Marshal the original Anthropic request\n\treqBody, err := json.Marshal(anthropicReq)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.ErrorRequests, 1)\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error marshaling passthrough request: %v\", err)\n\t\th.writeErrorResponse(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, \"api_error\", \"Error preparing request\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// Debug logging for passthrough request (secrets are masked)\n\tif h.cfg.DebugRequests {\n\t\tmaskedJSON := secrets.MaskJSONSecrets(reqBody)\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP DEBUG] Passthrough to Anthropic API:\\n%s\", string(maskedJSON))\n\t\t// Also log to dedicated debug file\n\t\tlogging.LogDebugRequestRaw(\"PASSTHROUGH\", \"/v1/messages\", maskedJSON)\n\t}\n\n\t// Execute request with retry logic\n\tresp, err := h.doRequestWithRetry(r.Context(), reqBody, p)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.ErrorRequests, 1)\n\t\tif h.circuitBreaker != nil {\n\t\t\th.circuitBreaker.RecordFailure()\n\t\t}\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error in passthrough request: %v\", err)\n\t\th.writeErrorResponse(w, http.StatusBadGateway, \"api_error\", \"Error connecting to Anthropic API\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tdefer resp.Body.Close()\n\n\t// Check for upstream errors\n\tif resp.StatusCode >= 400 {\n\t\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.ErrorRequests, 1)\n\t\tif h.circuitBreaker != nil && resp.StatusCode >= 500 {\n\t\t\th.circuitBreaker.RecordFailure()\n\t\t}\n\t\tbody, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)\n\t\t// Mask any secrets in error response before logging\n\t\tmaskedBody := secrets.MaskAllSecrets(string(body))\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Anthropic API error (%d): %s\", resp.StatusCode, maskedBody)\n\t\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n\t\tw.WriteHeader(resp.StatusCode)\n\t\t_, _ = w.Write(body) // Send original response to client\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// Record success for circuit breaker\n\tif h.circuitBreaker != nil {\n\t\th.circuitBreaker.RecordSuccess()\n\t}\n\n\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.SuccessRequests, 1)\n\tatomic.AddInt64(&h.metrics.TotalLatencyMs, time.Since(start).Milliseconds())\n\n\t// Add passthrough indicator header\n\tw.Header().Set(\"X-CLASP-Passthrough\", \"true\")\n\n\t// Handle streaming vs non-streaming passthrough\n\tif anthropicReq.Stream {\n\t\th.handlePassthroughStreaming(w, resp)\n\t} else {\n\t\th.handlePassthroughNonStreaming(w, resp, cacheKey, cacheable)\n\t}\n}\n\n// handlePassthroughStreaming streams the Anthropic response directly.\nfunc (h *Handler) handlePassthroughStreaming(w http.ResponseWriter, resp *http.Response) {\n\t// Set SSE headers\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"text/event-stream\")\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Cache-Control\", \"no-cache\")\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Connection\", \"keep-alive\")\n\tw.Header().Set(\"X-Accel-Buffering\", \"no\")\n\n\t// Flush headers\n\tif f, ok := w.(http.Flusher); ok {\n\t\tf.Flush()\n\t}\n\n\t// Stream response directly\n\tbuf := make([]byte, 4096)\n\tfor {\n\t\tn, err := resp.Body.Read(buf)\n\t\tif n > 0 {\n\t\t\tif _, writeErr := w.Write(buf[:n]); writeErr != nil {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error writing passthrough stream: %v\", writeErr)\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif f, ok := w.(http.Flusher); ok {\n\t\t\t\tf.Flush()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tif err != io.EOF {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error reading passthrough stream: %v\", err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// handlePassthroughNonStreaming handles non-streaming passthrough responses.\nfunc (h *Handler) handlePassthroughNonStreaming(w http.ResponseWriter, resp *http.Response, cacheKey string, cacheable bool) {\n\t// Read response body\n\tbody, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error reading passthrough response: %v\", err)\n\t\th.writeErrorResponse(w, http.StatusBadGateway, \"api_error\", \"Error reading upstream response\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// Debug logging (secrets are masked)\n\tif h.cfg.DebugResponses {\n\t\tmaskedBody := secrets.MaskJSONSecrets(body)\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP DEBUG] Passthrough response:\\n%s\", string(maskedBody))\n\t\t// Also log to dedicated debug file\n\t\tlogging.LogDebugRequestRaw(\"RESPONSE\", \"/v1/messages (passthrough)\", maskedBody)\n\t}\n\n\t// Parse response for caching and cost tracking\n\tvar anthropicResp models.AnthropicResponse\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(body, &anthropicResp); err == nil {\n\t\t// Track costs for passthrough\n\t\tif h.costTracker != nil && anthropicResp.Usage != nil {\n\t\t\th.costTracker.RecordUsage(\n\t\t\t\t\"anthropic\",\n\t\t\t\tanthropicResp.Model,\n\t\t\t\tanthropicResp.Usage.InputTokens,\n\t\t\t\tanthropicResp.Usage.OutputTokens,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Cache if enabled\n\t\tif h.cache != nil && cacheable && cacheKey != \"\" {\n\t\t\th.cache.Set(cacheKey, &anthropicResp)\n\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Passthrough response cached (key: %s...)\", cacheKey[:16])\n\t\t\th.tryStorePromptCache(cacheKey, &anthropicResp)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Write response\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n\tw.Header().Set(\"X-CLASP-Cache\", \"MISS\")\n\t_, _ = w.Write(body)\n}\n\n// doRequestWithRetry executes the upstream request with exponential backoff retry.\nfunc (h *Handler) doRequestWithRetry(ctx interface{ Done() <-chan struct{} }, reqBody []byte, p provider.Provider) (*http.Response, error) {\n\tmaxRetries := 3\n\tbaseDelay := 500 * time.Millisecond\n\n\tvar lastErr error\n\tfor attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {\n\t\t// Create fresh request for each attempt with context\n\t\tupstreamReq, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(context.Background(), http.MethodPost, p.GetEndpointURL(), bytes.NewReader(reqBody))\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"creating request: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Set headers (API key may be embedded in provider for tier routing)\n\t\tfor key, values := range p.GetHeaders(h.cfg.GetAPIKey()) {\n\t\t\tfor _, v := range values {\n\t\t\t\tupstreamReq.Header.Add(key, v)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tresp, err := h.client.Do(upstreamReq)\n\t\tif err == nil {\n\t\t\t// Check if we should retry based on status code\n\t\t\tif resp.StatusCode < 500 || resp.StatusCode == 529 { // Don't retry 5xx except overload\n\t\t\t\treturn resp, nil\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// Close response for retry\n\t\t\tresp.Body.Close()\n\t\t\tlastErr = fmt.Errorf(\"upstream returned %d\", resp.StatusCode)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tlastErr = err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Don't retry on last attempt\n\t\tif attempt < maxRetries-1 {\n\t\t\tdelay := baseDelay * time.Duration(1<<attempt) // Exponential backoff\n\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Retry %d/%d after %v: %v\", attempt+1, maxRetries, delay, lastErr)\n\n\t\t\tselect {\n\t\t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n\t\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"context canceled\")\n\t\t\tcase <-time.After(delay):\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"max retries exceeded: %w\", lastErr)\n}\n\n// getFallbackProvider returns the appropriate fallback provider and model for the given request model.\n// It checks tier-specific fallbacks first, then global fallback.\nfunc (h *Handler) getFallbackProvider(requestModel string) (provider.Provider, string) {\n\t// First check for tier-specific fallback\n\ttier := config.GetModelTier(requestModel)\n\tif fbProvider, ok := h.tierFallbacks[tier]; ok {\n\t\t// Get fallback model from tier config\n\t\ttierCfg := h.cfg.GetTierConfig(requestModel)\n\t\tif tierCfg != nil && tierCfg.FallbackModel != \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fbProvider, tierCfg.FallbackModel\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn fbProvider, \"\"\n\t}\n\n\t// Fall back to global fallback provider\n\tif h.fallbackProvider != nil {\n\t\treturn h.fallbackProvider, h.cfg.FallbackModel\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil, \"\"\n}\n\n// writeErrorResponse writes an Anthropic-formatted error response.\nfunc (h *Handler) writeErrorResponse(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, errType, message string) {\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n\tw.WriteHeader(status)\n\t_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\"type\": \"error\",\n\t\t\"error\": map[string]string{\n\t\t\t\"type\":    errType,\n\t\t\t\"message\": message,\n\t\t},\n\t})\n}\n\n// handleStreamingResponse handles SSE streaming responses.\nfunc (h *Handler) handleStreamingResponse(w http.ResponseWriter, resp *http.Response, targetModel string) {\n\t// Set SSE headers\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"text/event-stream\")\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Cache-Control\", \"no-cache\")\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Connection\", \"keep-alive\")\n\tw.Header().Set(\"X-Accel-Buffering\", \"no\")\n\n\t// Flush headers\n\tif f, ok := w.(http.Flusher); ok {\n\t\tf.Flush()\n\t}\n\n\t// Create flush writer\n\tfw := &flushWriter{w: w}\n\tif f, ok := w.(http.Flusher); ok {\n\t\tfw.flusher = f\n\t}\n\n\t// Generate message ID\n\tmessageID := generateMessageID()\n\n\t// Process stream\n\tprocessor := translator.NewStreamProcessor(fw, messageID, targetModel)\n\n\t// Set up cost tracking callback if cost tracker is available\n\tif h.costTracker != nil {\n\t\tprocessor.SetUsageCallback(func(inputTokens, outputTokens int) {\n\t\t\th.costTracker.RecordUsage(\n\t\t\t\th.provider.Name(),\n\t\t\t\ttargetModel,\n\t\t\t\tinputTokens,\n\t\t\t\toutputTokens,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Streaming cost tracked: %d input tokens, %d output tokens\", inputTokens, outputTokens)\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\tif err := processor.ProcessStream(resp.Body); err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error processing stream: %v\", err)\n\t}\n}\n\n// handleNonStreamingResponse handles non-streaming responses.\nfunc (h *Handler) handleNonStreamingResponse(w http.ResponseWriter, resp *http.Response, targetModel, cacheKey string, cacheable bool) {\n\t// Read response body\n\tbody, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error reading response: %v\", err)\n\t\thttp.Error(w, \"Error reading upstream response\", http.StatusBadGateway)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// Debug logging for raw response (secrets are masked)\n\tif h.cfg.DebugResponses {\n\t\tmaskedBody := compaction session tracking: after a successful\n// stream, the response ID is stored so the next request can use previous_response_id.\nfunc (h *Handler) handleResponsesStreamingResponse(w http.ResponseWriter, resp *http.Response, targetModel, sessionKey string, messageCount int) {\n\t// Set SSE headers\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Content-Type\", \"text/event-stream\")\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Cache-Control\", \"no-cache\")\n\tw.Header().Set(\"Connection\", \"keep-alive\")\n\tw.Header().Set(\"X-Accel-Buffering\", \"no\")\n\n\t// Flush headers\n\tif f, ok := w.(http.Flusher); ok {\n\t\tf.Flush()\n\t}\n\n\t// Create flush writer\n\tfw := &flushWriter{w: w}\n\tif f, ok := w.(http.Flusher); ok {\n\t\tfw.flusher = f\n\t}\n\n\t// Generate message ID\n\tmessageID := generateMessageID()\n\n\t// Process stream using Responses API processor\n\tprocessor := translator.NewResponsesStreamProcessor(fw, messageID, targetModel)\n\n\t// Set up cost tracking callback if cost tracker is available\n\tif h.costTracker != nil {\n\t\tprocessor.SetUsageCallback(func(inputTokens, outputTokens int) {\n\t\t\th.costTracker.RecordUsage(\n\t\t\t\th.provider.Name(),\n\t\t\t\ttargetModel,\n\t\t\t\tinputTokens,\n\t\t\t\toutputTokens,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Responses API streaming cost tracked: %d input tokens, %d output tokens\", inputTokens, outputTokens)\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\tif err := processor.ProcessStream(resp.Body); err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Error processing Responses API stream: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\n\t// Store response ID in session tracker for compaction.\n\tif responseID := processor.GetResponseID(); responseID != \"\" {\n\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Responses API response ID: %s\", responseID)\n\t\tif h.sessionTracker != nil && sessionKey != \"\" {\n\t\t\th.sessionTracker.Set(sessionKey, responseID, messageCount)\n\t\t\tlog.Printf(\"[CLASP] Compaction: stored session %s... (messages=%d)\", sessionKey[:8], messageCount)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// handleResponsesNonStreamingResponse handles non-streaming responses from Responses API.\n// sessionKey and messageCount enable *testing.T) {\n\tapiKey := os.Getenv(\"OPENAI_API_KEY\")\n\tif apiKey == \"\" {\n\t\tt.Skip(\"OPENAI_API_KEY not set, skipping integration test\")\n\t}\n\n\t// Create config with prompt cache aliases (empty by default)\n\t\tModelAliases: make(map[string]string),\n\t\t// Compaction defaults\n\t\tCompactionEnabled: false,\n\t\tSessionTimeoutSec: 3600, // 1 hour\n\t}\n}\n\n// LoadFromEnv loads configuration from environment variables.\nfunc LoadFromEnv() (*Config, error) {\n\tcfg := DefaultConfig()\n\n\t// Provider selection\n\tif provider := os.Getenv(\"PROVIDER\"); provider != \"\" Grok API key\n\tcfg.QwenAPIKey = os.Getenv(\"QWEN_API_KEY\")         // Alibaba Qwen API key\n\tcfg.MiniMaxAPIKey = os.Getenv(\"MINIMAX_API_KEY\")   // MiniMax API key\n\tcfg.LiteLLMAPIKey = baseURL != \"\" {\n\t\tcfg.GrokBaseURL = baseURL\n\t}\n\tif baseURL := os.Getenv(\"QWEN_BASE_URL\"); baseURL != \"\" {\n\t\tcfg.QwenBaseURL = baseURL\n\t}\n\tif baseURL := loadModelAliases()\n\n\t// Circuit breaker settings\n\tcfg.CircuitBreakerEnabled = os.Getenv(\"CLASP_CIRCUIT_BREAKER\") == \"true\" || os.Getenv(\"CLASP_CIRCUIT_BREAKER\") == \"1\"\n\tif threshold := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_MULTI_PROVIDER\") == \"true\" || os.Getenv(\"CLASP_MULTI_PROVIDER\") == \"1\"\n\tcfg.TierOpus = loadTierConfig(\"OPUS\", cfg)\n\tcfg.TierSonnet = loadTierConfig(\"SONNET\", cfg.AnthropicAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderCustom:\n\t\t\tcfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.CustomAPIKey\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Auto-detect provider from available API keys if not explicitly set\n\tif os.Getenv(\"PROVIDER\") == \"\" {\n\t\tcfg.Provider = detectProvider(cfg)\n\t}\n\n\t// Validate configuration\n\tif err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\treturn cfg, nil\n}\n\n// detectProvider determines the provider based on available API keys.\nfunc detectProvider(cfg *Config) ProviderType {\n\tif cfg.OpenAIAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderOpenAI\n\t}\n\tif cfg.OpenRouterAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderOpenRouter\n\t}\n\tif cfg.AzureAPIKey != \"\" && cfg.AzureEndpoint != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderAzure\n\t}\n\tif cfg.AnthropicAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderAnthropic\n\t}\n\tif cfg.GeminiAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderGemini\n\t}\n\tif cfg.DeepSeekAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderDeepSeek\n\t}\n\tif cfg.GrokAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderGrok\n\t}\n\tif cfg.QwenAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderQwen\n\t}\n\tif cfg.MiniMaxAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderMiniMax\n\t}\n\t// LiteLLM can work with or without API key, check base URL\n\tif cfg.LiteLLMBaseURL != \"\" && cfg.LiteLLMBaseURL != \"http://localhost:4000\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderLiteLLM\n\t}\n\t// Ollama doesn't require API key, check if base URL is set or use detection\n\tif cfg.OllamaBaseURL != \"\" && cfg.OllamaBaseURL != \"http://localhost:11434\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderOllama\n\t}\n\tif cfg.CustomAPIKey != \"\" && cfg.CustomBaseURL != \"\" {\n\t\treturn ProviderCustom\n\t}\n\treturn ProviderOpenAI // Default\n}\n\n// loadTierConfig loads tier-specific configuration from environment variables.\n// Pattern: CLASP_<TIER>_PROVIDER, CLASP_<TIER>_MODEL, CLASP_<TIER>_API_KEY, CLASP_<TIER>_BASE_URL\n// Fallback: CLASP_<TIER>_FALLBACK_PROVIDER, CLASP_<TIER>_FALLBACK_MODEL, etc.\nfunc loadTierConfig(tier string, cfg *Config) *TierConfig {\n\tprovider := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_\" + tier + \"_PROVIDER\")\n\tmodel := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_\" + tier + \"_MODEL\")\n\tapiKey := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_\" + tier + \"_API_KEY\")\n\tbaseURL := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_\" + tier + \"_BASE_URL\")\n\n\t// If no provider specified for this tier, return nil\n\tif provider == \"\" && model == \"\" {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\ttierCfg := &TierConfig{\n\t\tProvider: ProviderType(provider),\n\t\tModel:    model,\n\t\tAPIKey:   apiKey,\n\t\tBaseURL:  baseURL,\n\t}\n\n\t// If no explicit API key, inherit from main config based on provider\n\tif tierCfg.APIKey == \"\" {\n\t\tswitch tierCfg.Provider {\n\t\tcase ProviderOpenAI:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.OpenAIAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderOpenRouter:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.OpenRouterAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderAzure:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.AzureAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderAnthropic:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.AnthropicAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderOllama:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.OllamaAPIKey // Usually empty\n\t\tcase ProviderGemini:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.GeminiAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderDeepSeek:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.DeepSeekAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderGrok:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.GrokAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderQwen:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.QwenAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderMiniMax:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.MiniMaxAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderLiteLLM:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.LiteLLMAPIKey\n\t\tcase ProviderCustom:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.APIKey = cfg.CustomAPIKey\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// If no explicit base URL, use defaults based on provider\n\tif tierCfg.BaseURL == \"\" {\n\t\tswitch tierCfg.Provider {\n\t\tcase ProviderOpenAI:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.OpenAIBaseURL\n\t\tcase ProviderOpenRouter:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.OpenRouterBaseURL\n\t\tcase ProviderOllama:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.OllamaBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\t\tcase ProviderGemini:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.GeminiBaseURL + \"/openai\"\n\t\tcase ProviderDeepSeek:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.DeepSeekBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\t\tcase ProviderGrok:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.GrokBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\t\tcase ProviderQwen:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.QwenBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\t\tcase ProviderMiniMax:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.MiniMaxBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\t\tcase ProviderLiteLLM:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.LiteLLMBaseURL + \"/v1\"\n\t\tcase ProviderCustom:\n\t\t\ttierCfg.BaseURL = cfg.CustomBaseURL\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Load tier-specific fallback configuration\n\tfallbackProvider := os.Getenv(\"CLASP_\" + tier + \"_FALLBACK_PROVIDER\")\n\tif fallbackProvider != \"\" {\n\t\ttierCfg.FallbackProvider = ProviderType(fallbackProvider)\n\t\ttierCfg.FallbackModel = os.Getenv(\"CLASP_\" + tier + \"_FALLBACK_MODEL\")\n\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = os.Getenv(\"CLASP_\" + tier + \"_FALLBACK_API_KEY\")\n\t\ttierCfg.FallbackBaseURL = os.Getenv(\"CLASP_\" + tier + \"_FALLBACK_BASE_URL\")\n\n\t\t// Inherit fallback API key if not specified\n\t\tif tierCfg.FallbackAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\tswitch tierCfg.FallbackProvider {\n\t\t\tcase ProviderOpenAI:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.OpenAIAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderOpenRouter:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.OpenRouterAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderAzure:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.AzureAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderAnthropic:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.AnthropicAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderOllama:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.OllamaAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderGemini:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.GeminiAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderDeepSeek:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.DeepSeekAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderGrok:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.GrokAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderQwen:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.QwenAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderMiniMax:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.MiniMaxAPIKey\n\t\t\tcase ProviderCustom:\n\t\t\t\ttierCfg.FallbackAPIKey = cfg.CustomAPIKey\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn tierCfg\n}\n\n// Validate checks that the configuration is valid.\nfunc (c *Config) Validate() error {\n\tswitch c.Provider {\n\tcase ProviderOpenAI:\n\t\tif c.OpenAIAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"OPENAI_API_KEY is required for provider 'openai'\")\n\t\t}\n\tcase ProviderAzure:\n\t\tif c.AzureAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"AZURE_API_KEY is required for provider 'azure'\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tif c.AzureEndpoint == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT is required for provider 'azure'\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tif c.AzureDeploymentName == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"AZURE_DEPLOYMENT_NAME is required for provider 'azure'\")\n\t\t}\n\tcase ProviderOpenRouter:\n\t\tif c.OpenRouterAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"OPENROUTER_API_KEY is required for provider 'openrouter'\")\n\t\t}\n\tcase ProviderAnthropic:\n\t\tif c.AnthropicAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is required for provider 'anthropic'\")\n\t\t}\n\tcase ProviderOllama:\n\t\t// Ollama doesn't require API key - it runs locally\n\t\t// Base URL defaults to http://localhost:11434\n\tcase ProviderGemini:\n\t\tif c.GeminiAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"GEMINI_API_KEY is required for provider 'gemini'\")\n\t\t}\n\tcase ProviderDeepSeek:\n\t\tif c.DeepSeekAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is required for provider 'deepseek'\")\n\t\t}\n\tcase ProviderGrok:\n\t\tif c.GrokAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"GROK_API_KEY is required for provider 'grok'\")\n\t\t}\n\tcase ProviderQwen:\n\t\tif c.QwenAPIKey == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"QWEN_API_KEY is
